verdict.rationale: Sketch's developer site documents an official command-line tool, `sketchtool`, for creating assets with a single command and integrating Sketch into workflows. It also documents the official `skpm` plugin manager CLI for publishing plugins. Evidence is limited to brief first-party mentions, with nothing showing the CLI's command surface or agent-friendly use. Missing for 10: detailed CLI command reference, evidence of AI/agent-oriented CLI workflows (structured output, non-interactive automation), clarity on whether the CLI runs without the Mac app, independent or hands-on corroboration.
